neighbours.label: A mark where a quoted passage is cut or resumed: an ellipsis (...) inside a quotation or a closing quote mid-sentence; the same sentence without it stays quiet
fire: They logged trips "when the left or right engine" was running.
The parcel turned out to hold ... three jars of honey!
Its first page … opens by warning that it is incomplete.
Many sailors . . . left to found their own colonies.
The rule applies "where the owner or tenant" has signed.
Her bag turned out to contain ... a live chicken!
The latest report … starts by saying the data are old.
Many farmers . . . moved to seek their own land.
quiet: They logged trips when the left engine was running.
The parcel turned out to hold three jars of honey!
Its first page opens by warning that it is incomplete.
Many sailors left to found their own colonies.
The rule applies where the owner has signed.
Her bag turned out to contain a live chicken!
The latest report starts by saying the data are old.
Many farmers moved to seek their own land.

short: ellipsis or cut in a quotation
notes: Probes 0.09-0.26, so the median is at risk.
